literal.prompt: Какая охраняемая территория особенно известна европейским зубром?

literalGroups.primaryGround: UNESCO identifies Białowieża Forest as home to the largest free-roaming European-bison population (L35); the other three options are accurately grounded as Lake District, Cinque Terre, and Doñana in their individual notes. The prompt and key preserve a single geographic-feature association.
literalGroups.locator: UNESCO33 L29-L35; Lake facts L40-L63 and geology L42-L44; official Cinque Terre Park L416-L423 plus UNESCO826 L47-L49; UNESCO685 L46/L49/L58

literalGroups.literal: Это Беловежская пуща. Она сохраняет участки старовозрастного равнинного леса.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The English synthesis describes protected Central European lowland mixed forest and extensive old-growth areas, supporting the explanation that Białowieża preserves old-growth lowland forest.

literalGroups.literal: Лейк-Дистрикт — английский национальный парк с ледниковыми озёрами и высочайшей горой Англии.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The Lake District geology page says glaciers and meltwater sculpted the landscape and specifically calls it home to England’s highest mountain (singular); the official facts page lists Scafell Pike as the highest. This corrects only the unsupported plural wording.
literalGroups.locator: Lake geology L42-L44; Lake facts L40, L52-L55

literalGroups.literal: Чинкве-Терре — итальянский парк и культурный ландшафт пяти прибрежных деревень на террасированных склонах.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The official Cinque Terre National Park page identifies the park and five hamlets, and says its famous landscape is made of cultivated terraces on steep slopes; UNESCO names Cinque Terre collectively as five villages and describes the terraced Ligurian coast.
literalGroups.locator: Official Cinque Terre Park L416-L423; UNESCO826 L47-L50

literalGroups.literal: Доньяна — испанский парк водно-болотных угодий у устья Гвадалквивира, важный для перелётных птиц.
literalGroups.primaryGround: UNESCO calls Doñana a Spanish national park and exceptional wetland at the Guadalquivir estuary; it describes an important resting refuge for breeding, wintering and migrating birds. “Устье” narrows the inaccurate “дельта”.

literalGroups.literal: Беловежская пуща — древний лес на границе Польши и Беларуси, где живёт крупнейшая свободная популяция зубров.
literalGroups.primaryGround: UNESCO locates Białowieża Forest on the Poland–Belarus border, describes its old-growth lowland forests, and identifies the property as home to the largest free-roaming population of European Bison.
